questions.question: Next to a change it says +12 -1. What does that mean?

options.text: Twelve lines were added and one was removed
options.explanation: Correct. Click the numbers to see the changes in more detail in the diff.

options.text: There are twelve errors in the code
options.explanation: The numbers say nothing about errors. They tell you how many lines were added and removed.
There are no points to collect here. The numbers tell you how many lines changed.

questions.question: Do you need to understand every line of code in the diff?

options.text: No. It’s enough that the change is in the right file and looks sensible
options.explanation: Exactly. If something looks odd, comment on the line or ask Claude.

options.text: Yes, otherwise you can’t accept the change
options.explanation: Nobody expects that of a beginner. Ask Claude if a change puzzles you.

options.text: You don’t need to look at the diff at all
options.explanation: It’s worth looking. That way you’ll notice if Claude changed the wrong file.
